mainEntity.name: How do I cancel, and am I tied in?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no tie-in. You can cancel anytime by logging into your account and going to your subscriptions — cancelling simply stops your next monthly payment. There's no minimum term and no cancellation fee.

mainEntity.name: Does my monthly review session roll over if I don't use it?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your membership includes one review session per calendar month, and it doesn't carry over to the next month if unused. The monthly rhythm is deliberately designed to keep you making steady progress.

mainEntity.name: What software and equipment do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A digital camera, a computer with an internet connection, and Dropbox for sharing your images. Sessions are held over Zoom. You don't need to own Lightroom, though it helps if you want to follow the editing side closely.

mainEntity.name: Can I send RAW files for review?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — feel free to upload RAW as well as JPEG if you'd like deeper editing guidance. A minimum of 3000px on the long edge is ideal for review.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to have done a course first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Many members join after a beginners or Lightroom course to keep the momentum going, but Foundation Plus works just as well as a standalone way to keep improving with regular structure and feedback.

mainEntity.name: How does the Practice Pack Library work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once you join, you get access to 30 assignments across three categories — technical, creative and genre-specific. There's no set order: pick whatever you want to strengthen, download the PDF, shoot the tasks, and bring your images to your monthly review.
Yes — additional 1-2-1 sessions can be booked separately anytime, and as a member you get 10% off those and on workshops too.

mainEntity.name: Is this suitable if I'm working towards an RPS distinction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Very much so. Working through the assignments builds the varied body of work a Licentiate panel needs, and several members have passed their LRPS using images made for the monthly assignments. For dedicated panel support, see the RPS distinctions mentoring page.

Payments are non-refundable. Once a month's subscription has been taken, it's locked in for that month. You can cancel anytime to stop future payments, and you keep access for the month you've already paid for.

mainEntity.name: What times can I book my monthly session?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book your 15-minute session any time within your billing month. The scheduler shows times in your local time zone. Alan's usual availability is weekdays 9am–5pm and weekends 10am–1pm (UK time).
